title: Composite Quality — GP+PiotroskiF+DeltaROE+(-Accruals) + BRK overlay

design.concept: L-512(GP IC 0.208) + L-517(PiotroskiF OOS 2.64) + L-511(Accruals gate) 결합. 단일 Quality composite 팩터 + STR_1060 검증 overlay. STR_1099(PiotroskiF Grade B)의 업그레이드.
design.signal: z(GPA) + z(PiotroskiF) + z(DeltaROE) + z(-Accruals_TTM), EW, sector neutral

overlay.dd_brake: DD_med only (start 4%, 1-day lagged, no short DD)

overfitting_guard: 4-signal composite 가중 EW = 최소 과적합. L-513과 유사하나 Rev21d 제외(turnover 감소).
